title: Analyzing Bias in False Refusal Behavior of Large Language Models for Hate Speech Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a bias ratio by comparing the proportion of nationality-targeted hate speech in LLM false refusals against its base prevalence in the dataset, annotated via the HolisticBias taxonomy using Phi-4 as a judge.

Comparing false refusal rates and safety alignment sensitivities across English, French, Spanish, German, Chinese, and Korean hate speech datasets to evaluate cross-lingual robustness and bias in moderation algorithms.
